title: Pure Archfiend
summary: Pure Archfiend Fiend control and self-destruction engine with Tour Guide From the Underworld, Fiendish Rhino Warrior and generic staples. Sending or destroying Archfiend Heiress and Archfiend Cavalry searches any Archfiend card and revives Level 8 bosses.

summary.title: Starters
points: Archfiend Heiress searches any Archfiend card from the Deck whenever she is sent to the GY by a card effect or destroyed by battle.
Tour Guide From the Underworld Special Summons Archfiend Heiress orFiendish Rhino Warrior from the Deck for an immediate Link-2 (Muckraker From the Underworld or Masterking Archfiend) or Rank 3 play.
Fiendish Rhino Warrior and Foolish Burial send Archfiend Heiress directly from the Deck to the GY to trigger her search for Archfiend Palabyrinth, Archfiend Emperor or Falling Down.

summary.title: Opening: Tour Guide or Foolish Burial / Rhino Warrior
steps: Send Archfiend Heiress to the GY with Foolish Burial or Fiendish Rhino Warrior (or summon her via Tour Guide and discard a card with Muckraker From the Underworld), triggering Heiress to search Archfiend Palabyrinth.
Activate Archfiend Palabyrinth, then Normal Summon Archfiend Cavalry or Special Summon Archfiend Commander.

Banish a Fiend from your GY to activate Archfiend Palabyrinth, banishing another Fiend you control to Special Summon a second Archfiend of the same Level (such as Archfiend Emperor at Level 8 or Archfiend Commander at Level 6) from the hand, Deck or GY.

summary.title: Self-Destruction & Floating Loop
summary.text: Archfiend Commander Special Summons itself while you control an Archfiend card and destroys 1 Archfiend card you control on summon; Archfiend Emperor, the First Lord of Horror can be Normal Summoned without Tributing at half stats and banishes an Archfiend from your hand or GY to destroy any card on the field; and Archfiend's Roar pays 500 LP to revive an Archfiend and destroys it in the End Phase. Pointing any of those destruction effects at Archfiend Cavalry or Archfiend Empress triggers them in the GY to revive Emperor or another high-Level Fiend at full 3000 ATK.

summary.title: Spells, Traps & Extra Deck
points: Falling Down is an Equip Spell searchable by Archfiend Heiress that permanently takes control of an opponent's monster while you control an Archfiend card.
Call of the Archfiend discards a Fiend monster (triggering Heiress if sent by effect) to revive a Level 5 or higher Fiend every turn.

Muckraker From the Underworld discards a card to revive any Fiend from the GY, while Archfiend's Ascent (Rank 6), Archfiend's Call (Level 6 Synchro) and Archfiend's Manifestation (Level 6 Fusion) take advantage of Archfiend Palabyrinth's Level-matching summon.

allow.Tour Guide From the Underworld: Normal Summon starter that summons Archfiend Heiress or Archfiend Eccentrick directly from the Deck.
allow.Fiendish Rhino Warrior: Protects Fiends or sends Archfiend Heiress from the Deck to the GY when sent to the GY.
allow.Foolish Burial: Sends Archfiend Heiress to the GY to search any Archfiend card.
allow.Terraforming: Searches the Archfiend Palabyrinth Field Spell.
allow.Muckraker From the Underworld: Link-2 Fiend that revives an Archfiend from the GY by discarding a card (which triggers Heiress).

main: Archfiend Heiress
Core searcher that adds any Archfiend card from Deck to hand when sent to the GY by card effect or battle.
Archfiend Emperor, the First Lord of Horror
Can be Normal Summoned without Tributing; banishes an Archfiend from hand/GY to destroy any card on the field.
Archfiend Empress
Protects DARK Fiend monsters from destruction by banishing a Fiend from the GY and floats into a Level 6+ Fiend.
Archfiend Commander
Special Summons itself if you control an Archfiend card and destroys an Archfiend to trigger Cavalry or Heiress.
Archfiend Cavalry
Revives any other Archfiend monster from the GY when destroyed by a card effect and sent to the GY.
Archfiend Eccentrick
Pendulum scale that destroys a Spell/Trap or tributes itself on field to destroy a monster, triggering Heiress when searched.
Tour Guide From the Underworld
Summons Archfiend Heiress from Deck for an instant Link-2 or Rank 3 play.
Fiendish Rhino Warrior
Dumps Archfiend Heiress from the Deck to trigger her search effect immediately.
Archfiend Palabyrinth
Field Spell that boosts Fiends by 500 ATK and banishes a Fiend to summon an Archfiend of the same Level from hand, Deck, or GY.
Falling Down
Equip Spell that permanently steals an opponent's monster while you control an Archfiend card.
Archfiend's Roar
Pays 500 LP to revive any Archfiend monster and destroys it during the End Phase, triggering Cavalry or Empress.
Call of the Archfiend
Continuous Trap that discards a Fiend (triggering Heiress) to revive a Level 5 or higher Fiend every turn.
Foolish Burial
Sends Archfiend Heiress to the GY to search Palabyrinth, Emperor, or Falling Down.
Terraforming
Searches Archfiend Palabyrinth.
extra: Link-2 Archfiend that sends Fiends to the GY when you pay LP and recycles upon dice roll.
Rank 6 Xyz summoned via Commander that protects from card effect destruction.
Level 6 Synchro that cannot be targeted by opponent's card effects.
Fusion monster that Special Summons Summoned Skull or an Archfiend when sent to the GY.
Discards Heiress to revive Emperor or Empress from the GY.
